name: Miranda
summary: A patchwork moon with cliffs up to 20 km high, some of the tallest in the solar system.

elements.source: JPL planetary satellite mean elements; mean anomaly and its rate refitted to JPL Horizons positions (2000-2045) on 2026-10-19 by tools/fit_moons.mjs
elements.i_note: Measured from Uranus's IAU north pole. Uranus spins backwards, so its moons, about 0 degrees from their own orbit pole in JPL's table, sit near 180 here.
